title: INHERIT Conformance Declaration
description: Machine-readable declaration of an implementation's conformance to the INHERIT standard. Governance requires two independent Level 2 implementations to promote schemas from draft to stable

implementation.description: Name of the implementation (product, service, or library)

implementationVersion.description: Version of the implementation being declared

inheritVersion.description: INHERIT schema version this declaration applies to

conformanceLevel.description: Overall conformance level achieved. The minimum across all declared entities

declaredAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this declaration was generated

validatorDetails.description: Details of the validator used to verify conformance

entities.description: Per-entity conformance results. Keys are entity schema names (e.g. 'estate', 'person', 'bequest')

extensions.description: Per-extension conformance results. Keys are extension identifiers (e.g. 'uk-england-wales', 'islamic-succession')

notes.description: Free-text notes about this conformance declaration

provenance.description: Consolidated provenance metadata — how this entity was created, by whom, and whether a human has verified it

disclaimer.description: Legal disclaimer on validation results. Validation checks JSON Schema conformance and referential integrity. It does not verify legal accuracy, completeness, or suitability for any jurisdiction's requirements
disclaimer.const: Validation results are informational. They verify schema conformance and data structure, not legal accuracy or completeness. Do not rely on validation results as the sole basis for legal or financial decisions.

EntityConformance.description: Conformance result for a single entity schema

passed.description: Whether the entity passed at the declared level

errors.description: Number of validation errors (0 if passed)

skipped.description: Whether this entity was skipped (not applicable to this implementation)

ExtensionConformance.description: Conformance result for a single extension

passed.description: Whether the extension passed at the declared level

jurisdictionsVerified.description: Which jurisdictions were verified for Level 3
